slides.texte_overlay:
7 things I wish I knew
at a young age

1. Your reputation
arrives before you do.
Build it early.

2. Nobody is watching
as closely as you think.
Try the thing.

3. Call your grandparents.
Their stories won't
be there forever.

4. Take photos of
ordinary days.
They become the best ones.

5. Learn to cook early.
It's freedom on a plate.

6. The right people
don't make you chase them.

7. Curiosity is a superpower.
Feed it every day.
